ReleaseNotes:  Enhanced Log Viewer
- Added Search and Filter modes for quickly locating log entries.
- Added Previous/Next navigation through search results.
- Added severity filtering for Errors, Warnings, Recovery, Success, and
Normal entries.
- Added keyboard navigation including F3, Shift+F3, Enter, and Shift+Enter.
- Added Ctrl+F support for searching selected text.
- Added absolute source-file line numbers.
- Added a current-line indicator showing the selected line and total line
count.
- Added Ctrl+G / Go to Line for jumping directly to a specific log line.
- Improved navigation so selected search results and Go to Line targets are
brought clearly into view.
- Improved multi-line selection and copying of complete log entries.
- Added double-click word highlighting.
- Improved reading-position preservation during automatic log refreshes.
 Log Bookmarks
- Added session-based bookmarks for important log lines.
- Use Ctrl+B to quickly add or remove a bookmark.
- Added Previous and Next bookmark navigation with wraparound.
- Added bookmark markers directly in the line-number gutter.
- Added bookmark position and count information.
- Added Clear All Bookmarks for the currently selected log.
- Added a bookmark filter to show only bookmarked log entries.
- Bookmark filtering works together with existing search and severity
filters.
- Added clearer two-color bookmark action icons for easier identification.
 Development Mode
- Added a DEV MODE indicator to the main application window.
- Added a subtle pulsing activity indicator while Development Mode is active.
- The Logs tab is automatically available when Development Mode is enabled.
- Verbose logging is automatically enforced during Development Mode without
changing the user's normal saved logging preference.
 Improvements
 Refined the Logs tab integration and added a dedicated close control.
 Improved Log Viewer navigation, filtering, selection, and status feedback.
 Improved bookmark controls and visual feedback.
 Improved the overall diagnostic workflow for development and troubleshooting.
